About Us

Karnataka's Trusted Home for Heirloom Silk

Nakshatra Kanchipuram Society was founded on a simple belief — every silk saree carries a story, and its true worth in zari, dye and craftsmanship deserves an honest price. We've built our name saree by saree, home by home, across Bengaluru and Karnataka.

Fair, Transparent Pricing

Every saree is weighed and evaluated in front of you, based on silk purity, zari content and condition — no hidden deductions.

Instant Cash Payment

Once you accept our quote, payment is made on the spot — cash or instant UPI transfer, your choice.

Doorstep Service

Our experts travel to you anywhere in Karnataka, so your precious silks never have to leave your home unattended.

Certified Silk Experts

Decades of combined experience identifying genuine Kanchipuram, Mysore and Banarasi silk weaves and zari grades.

What We Buy

Every Silk Saree Has a Home Here

Whether it's been in the family for decades or worn just once at a wedding, if it's pure silk — we want to give it a fair value.

Kanchipuram Silk Sarees

Traditional temple-border and zari-woven Kanchipuram silks, any age or condition.

Mysore Silk Sarees

Pure crepe and zari Mysore silk sarees, including vintage government-mark pieces.

Banarasi Silk Sarees

Brocade and zari-work Banarasi silks with intricate motifs and borders.

Bridal & Wedding Silks

Heavy zari bridal sarees worn once and preserved — we value the craftsmanship, not just the wear.

Old & Antique Silks

Heirloom sarees passed through generations, including discontinued weaves and designs.

Pure Zari Border Silks

Sarees with genuine gold or silver zari borders and pallus, evaluated by weight and purity.

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you'd want to know before selling your silk saree to us.

Price depends on the silk purity, zari content (gold/silver/imitation), weight, weave type and overall condition. We evaluate each saree individually and explain the pricing to you transparently before any offer is made.

Yes. Even if a saree has tears, stains or damage, the silk fabric and zari still hold value. We evaluate it accordingly and offer a fair price based on the recoverable silk and zari content.

Absolutely. Our evaluation visit anywhere in Karnataka is completely free with no obligation to sell. You only proceed if you're happy with the quoted price.

Payment is instant. Once you accept our quote, we pay on the spot — either in cash or via UPI transfer, whichever you prefer.

We currently serve Bengaluru, Mysuru, Kanchipuram and over 30 towns and cities across Karnataka. Contact us to confirm a visit to your location.

There's no minimum. Whether you have one heirloom saree or an entire collection, we're happy to evaluate and make an offer.
